#!/usr/bin/env bash
#flux: --job-name=ICTV_VMR_makeblastdb_e
#flux: --output=logs/log.%J.ICTV_VMR_makeblastdb_e.out
#flux: --error=logs/log.%J.ICTV_VMR_makeblastdb_e.out
#flux: --ntasks=1
#flux: --cpus-per-task=1
#flux: --time=12:00:00
#flux: --mem-per-node=30G
# The Slurm partition directive '--partition=amd-hdr100' does not have a direct Flux equivalent.
# This is a site-specific policy and is often handled by resource constraints or queue policies.
# The Slurm output format specifier '%x' (job name) is not supported in Flux's --output/--error directives.
# The job name has been manually inserted into the filename.
# The Slurm directive '--mem-per-cpu=30000' was translated to '--mem-per-node=30G' as the job
# requests a single task with a single CPU.

ACCESSION_TSV=processed_accessions_e.tsv
ALL_FASTA=./fasta_new_vmr/vmr_e.fa
SRC_DIR=$(dirname $ALL_FASTA)

echo "# concatenate individual fasta's into all.fa"
# if any fastas are updated, rebuild master fasta
if [[ ! -e "$ALL_FASTA" || "$(find $SRC_DIR -newer $ALL_FASTA|wc -l)" -gt 0 ]]; then
    echo "REBUILD $ALL_FASTA"
    rm $ALL_FASTA
    for FA in $(awk 'BEGIN{FS="\t";GENUS=5;ACC=3}(NR>1){print $GENUS"/"$ACC".raw"}' $ACCESSION_TSV); do
	echo "cat $SRC_DIR/$FA >> $ALL_FASTA"
	cat $SRC_DIR/$FA >> $ALL_FASTA
	wc -l $ALL_FASTA
    done
else
    echo "SKIP: $ALL_FASTA is up-to-date."
fi


echo "# Make the BLAST database"
if [ "$(which makeblastdb 2>/dev/null)" == "" ]; then 
    echo "module load BLAST"
    module load BLAST
fi

echo 'makeblastdb -in $ALL_FASTA -input_type "fasta" -title "ICTV VMR refseqs" -out "./blast/ICTV_VMR_e" -dbtype "nucl"'
makeblastdb -in $ALL_FASTA -input_type "fasta" -title "ICTV VMR refseqs" -out "./blast/ICTV_VMR_e" -dbtype "nucl"

echo "# Example usage:"
echo "# blastn -db ./blast/ICTV_VMR_e -query ./fasta_new_vmr/Eponavirus/MG711462.fa -out ./results/e/Eponavirus/MG711462.csv  -outfmt '7 delim=,'"

reasons: The directive '--ntasks=1' is not a valid Flux option.
The directive '--cpus-per-task=1' is not a valid Flux option.
The directive '--mem-per-node=30G' is not a valid Flux option.
